name: hes_init_file_list
note: startup: dos_get_drive(&DS:8e90), dos_set_drive(DAT_8e92), hes_list(&DS:8c5c) = enumerate *.HES; called once from game_main

name: disk_detect
note: far (retf) though Ghidra marks unknown; returns 2 if 500.HES is missing (hes_filesize(500)==-1), else 1; used by save/load menu (1581:4135)

name: timer_pause
note: nesting counter DS:0d02--; at 0 -> clock_suspend()+drive_io_begin(). Bracket around every disk access (pair: timer_resume)

name: timer_resume
note: DS:0d02++; at 1 -> drive_io_end()+clock_resume()

name: drive_io_begin
note: empty lib stub 44f5:000f, DS:0d04++ (debug counter), debug_nop()

name: drive_io_end
note: dos_disk_reset (INT21/0D), stub, DS:0d04--

name: debug_nop
note: empty far function (retf); called after debug counters 0d04/0d06 change

name: hes_load_raw
note: size=hes_size_or_ask_disk(n,&tmp,1); far_calloc(size,1); hes_read_into; returns far ptr in DX:AX; caller frees with far_free

name: hes_read_into
note: timer_pause; hes_load(n,buf) (4500:0006); timer_resume. callers ADD SP,6

name: hes_load_unpack0
note: loads packed sprite bank and unpacks with hes_unpack_sprites(src,dst,mode=0); returns new far_calloc'd bank (DX:AX)

name: hes_load_unpack
note: same as hes_load_unpack0 but unpack mode 1 (56 call sites: rooms/UI sprites)

name: rand_range
note: srand((long)(ticks_get()+seed+DAT_8e8c:8e8e)); return rand()%n+1 (1..n). TC rand LCG must be reproduced

name: clock_reset
note: ticks_reset(); ticks_set(0); game-time accumulator DS:6123/6125 (int32)=0; DS:0d06++

name: clock_suspend
note: if !clock_stopped(DS:7a72): accum(6123,int32) += ticks_get()*DAT_7282 (sec per tick); timer_shutdown stub; DS:0d06--

name: clock_resume
note: ticks_reset(); ticks_set(0); DS:6121 (last sim tick) = -(50/speed DAT_7a30); DS:0d06++

name: clock_get_cached
note: *out = DS:0d0a (last value computed by clock_get_seconds)

name: clock_get_seconds
note: game time in seconds since 17:00 = accum/50 + (ticks/50)*DAT_7282; renormalises when ticks>59999; writes hour DS:71ca (17..23,0,1), minute 71cc, second 71ce, cache 0d0a

name: spritebank_fix_pointers
note: recomputes Bitmap.pixels of every entry: pixels start after header (2+count*8), each entry wcols*h*8 bytes

name: far_free_ptr
note: far_free(*pp); *pp=NULL

name: figure_frame_bytes
note: returns (DAT_836e [+DAT_836a if with_extra]) * w / 8 as long (LXMUL/LDIV); only called with (0x130,1); 836e derived from size of HES 4 bank in game_main

name: hes_size_or_ask_disk
c_signature: int16_t hes_size_or_ask_disk(int16_t hes_no, int16_t *unpacked_size, int16_t mode)
note: Ghidra shows 1 param; callers push 4 words (ADD SP,8). loops hes_sprite_info(no,&size,unpacked_size,mode) until size!=-1, showing disk-change dialog 38b6:0a88 (text 0x11f if no<301 else 0x1ad) and waiting for click via game_tick; returns file size

name: font_load
c_signature: void font_load(int16_t hes_no, int16_t slot, int16_t mode)
note: actually a generic packed-sprite-bank cache: hes_size_or_ask_disk(n,&cache[slot].unpacked,mode); cache[slot].raw=hes_load_raw(n); cache = DS:7be0, 6 bytes/slot {void *raw; int16 unpacked_size}

name: font_get
note: unpacks cached raw bank cache[slot] (DS:7be0) into new far_calloc(unpacked_size) via hes_unpack_sprites(...,mode); returns DX:AX; used for building sprites (slot 2/3) and TV pictures (DS:05a0 table)

name: figure_sprites_load_all
note: for players 0..2: figure_sprites_load(0x11+p or 0x18 if human figure state==2, p); slots 3,4 = HES 0x14,0x15; slot 5 = 0x17 or 0x16 depending on DAT_7a3c (event)

name: figure_sprites_load
note: if DS:0d0c[slot]!=hes_no: unpack HES into temp and far_memcpy pixel data into big figure bank DAT_00f8 at slot*frame_bytes*10+0x1e2; caches hes in 0d0c[slot]

name: far_calloc
note: farcalloc((ulong)n,(ulong)size); returns DX:AX

name: far_free
note: farfree(p)

name: clock_stop
note: nesting counter DS:0d08++; on first: accumulate elapsed ticks into DS:6123 (int32), ticks_set(0), clock_stopped DS:7a72=1

name: text_get_copy
note: far_calloc(500,1) + far_memcpy of UI string table entry DS:8370[id] (far char*, 430 entries from language file idx0 = 199/253.HES); caller must far_free
